items.prompt:
Writing organized in sentences and paragraphs is:
A) prose
B) a poem
C) a drama

A group of lines in a poem is a:
A) scene
B) stanza
C) chapter

A play (with characters and scenes) is also called a:
A) poem
B) drama
C) report

Notes in a play that tell actors how to move are:
A) stanzas
B) stage directions
C) chapters

A text with character names, spoken lines, and scenes is a:
A) poem
B) drama
C) novel in prose

steps: Features of a play. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Which form is MOST likely to use stanzas and rhyme?
A) a poem
B) a chapter book
C) a stage play

steps: Poems use stanzas/rhyme. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which structural feature belongs to DRAMA but NOT to prose or poems?
A) sentences
B) stage directions and a cast of characters
C) a title
items.answer: B) stage directions and a cast of characters

steps: Unique to plays. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) stage directions and a cast of characters

items.prompt:
A writer wants readers to act out the story on a stage. The BEST form is:
A) a poem
B) a drama (play)
C) a paragraph of prose

steps: Plays are meant to be performed. Key is B.
